r_addition_window_leadtime.subject: procurement_windows
r_addition_window_leadtime.content: Windows and exterior doors are ordered at least 21 calendar days before demolition start.

r_addition_weathertight_gate.subject: weathertight_gate
r_addition_weathertight_gate.content: Insulation and drywall are never scheduled before the shell is weathertight and rough inspections have passed.

r_addition_roof_tiein_photos.subject: roof_tie_in
r_addition_roof_tiein_photos.content: When a new roof ties into or over-frames an existing roof, existing conditions are photo-documented on day one of roof framing.
r_addition_roof_tiein_photos.notes: Concealed roof tie-in is the top change-order source on additions.

r_addition_septic_trigger.subject: septic_trigger
r_addition_septic_trigger.content: Any added bedroom or bathroom on a septic property triggers a TDEC septic evaluation before permit submittal.

r_addition_service_capacity.subject: electrical_capacity
r_addition_service_capacity.content: Existing main-service capacity is verified before any subpanel or HVAC equipment order is placed.
